frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Bouchaud & Potters' statistical-physics Lévy/stable mechanism for fat tails: symmetric Lévy laws via the characteristic function exp(-a_µ|z|^µ), power-law Paretian tails L_µ(x) ~ µA±^µ/|x|^{1+µ} with tail amplitudes as generalized cumulants and asymmetry β, recovering the Gaussian at µ=2, per Bouchaud & Potters (2003) Ch.1 §1.8.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Lévy-Stable Laws and Paretian Tails: The Physics Origin of Fat Tails
